rationale.approved: 2026-11-07 direct user adoption: kompuls=迫ᴷ, langvor=疲ᴸᴺ, setl=住ˢ. kompuls shares 迫 with persekut and opres while preserving the sense of compelling someone to carry out a duty or action. langvor shares 疲 with lac while retaining lack of energy, languor and emotional/poetic senses in the existing glosses. setl shares 住 with loĝ, preserving settlement in a new place and the group nuance. Former 逼,倦,居 are meaningful; the approved choice favors reuse and removal of three dedicated characters. Body strokes 12/10/8 to 8/10/7, total 30 to 25. No new character introduced. Existing bare owners and all other root identifiers remain unchanged. rikan and sponsor are not adopted. Master classifications remain content; F/band, original dictionary, decomposition, detailed glosses, short JA/ZH/KO annotations, markers and the fixed original legacy are unchanged. Current and fixed original legacy only; no intermediate edition or old-spelling aliases.

migration_notice: Only current kompuls, langvor and setl change. Other owners and fixed legacy assignments stay unchanged. No old-spelling aliases or intermediate editions.
